OCT 12 | EMAIL

Design email. Side by side layout, 2 columns.

2 tests. 2 different questions.

Purity is only half of it.

HPLC And Mass SpecDo Not Do The Same Job

One tells you how pure. The other tells you what it is. You need both.

View Lab Reports

Side By Side

HPLC

Separates the sample and measures how much of it is the target compound. Answers: how pure?

LC-MS

Measures molecular mass and confirms the sequence. Answers: is this actually the compound on the label?

Why Purity Alone Is Not Enough

A sample can be 99% pure and still be 99% of the wrong molecule.

Purity without identity confirmation is a number with nothing attached to it.

See Both On Every Report

OCT 19 | EMAIL

Design email.

The 2 fields most buyers skip

Purity gets all the attention.

Everyone Checks Purity.Almost Nobody Checks These.

2 fields on a lab report that tell you more than the headline percentage.

Shop With the Data

1. Measured Net Content

Purity is a ratio. Net content is a quantity. A vial can be highly pure and still hold less than the label says.

Every Onyx report publishes measured net content against labeled quantity.

2. Whether The Lab Is Reachable

A certificate from a lab with no website, no contact details and no presence outside the supplier's own materials is not third party verification.

View Lab Reports

Strictly for in-vitro laboratory research use only. Not for human or animal consumption. All materials are subject to rigorous purity standards. Proprietary research information enclosed.

OCT 21 | EMAIL

Design email.

A lab report, field by field

Here is where everything sits.

How To Read AnOnyx Lab Report

6 fields, top to bottom. Here is what each one tells you.

View Lab Reports

Top To Bottom

Report number and date. When the testing happened. Batch. Which lot the report covers. Labeled quantity. What the vial says. Batch average purity. HPLC result against the reference standard. Batch average net content. Measured weight. Identity confirmation. LC-MS result.

Then Keep Going

Below that: heavy metal screening across arsenic, cadmium, lead and mercury. Endotoxin against a stated limit. Per vial conformity. The chromatogram itself.

OCT 23 | EMAIL

Design email.

We test 2 vials, not 1

The section nobody reads.

The Part Of The ReportMost People Scroll Past

Batch conformity. It shows variation inside a single lot, vial by vial.

View the Full Report

Why Pull More Than One Vial

A batch average can hide spread. Testing a single vial tells you about that vial.

Our reports break out each sampled vial separately, purity and net content, then show the average.

Also On Every Report

Heavy metals screened across 4 analytes. Endotoxin tested against a stated limit of 0.5 EU/mL.

Neither appears on most certificates in this market.

See the Conformity Data
